items.description: Prewired 1000mm green AWG30 solid-wire receptacle; candidate only

Machined FR-4 support carrier 36.6 x 54 x 5 mm: 7 through windows over the probe field and every B-face part and lead (internal radius 1.0 mm, walls and webs at least 1.0 mm), 3 datum pin holes 2.0 mm (press fit), 2 dowel holes 2.0 mm, 6 M3 holes countersunk 90 degrees to 6.0 mm, 2 guide-standoff holes 3.4 mm; geometry in fixture-assembly.step and manifest.json; fabricator not selected

Machined FR-4 probe plate 36.6 x 54 x 6 mm: 5 receptacle bores 0.99 mm (finished 0.98-1.00 mm, drilled, 0.40 mm web at the 1.4 mm test-point pitch), one J5 lead window (internal radius 1.1 mm), 2 dowel holes 2.0 mm, 6 M3 holes 3.4 mm; no component pockets

Machined FR-4 pressure plate 37.2 x 16 x 6 mm (rigid): J5 notch (internal radius 1.1 mm), 2 stop holes 3.4 mm (G1, G2), 2 M4 tapped holes (3.3 mm drill, at least 1.0 mm web at the 4.0 mm thread) for the hold-down plungers
Machined FR-4 base plate 36.6 x 54 x 3 mm: 6 M3 holes countersunk to 6.0 mm, cable-tie slot 4 x 2 mm (radius 0.8 mm)
Dowel pins 2.0 x 6 mm, hardened steel, press fit in the carrier, 1.0 mm above the carrier top: X1, X2 on the x = 16.2 board edge, Y1 on the y = 62.9 edge
Dowel pins 2.0 x 16 mm, hardened steel m6, through probe plate and carrier (D1, D2) from the probe-plate underside, ending 1.0 mm below the carrier top, aligning the bores to the datum pins
M3 x 8 countersunk screws (ISO 10642 / DIN 7991), carrier top flush
M3 hex spacers female-female 6 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, between carrier and probe plate
M3 x 12 set screws used as studs through the probe plate
M3 hex standoffs female-female 35 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, between probe plate and base plate
M3 x 8 countersunk screws (DIN 7991 / ISO 10642), base underside flush, 5 mm into the 35 mm standoff thread

M3 hex standoffs female-female 6 mm, 5.5 mm across flats, on the carrier top (G1, G2) as hard stops for the pressure plate (top at 6.0 mm above the carrier, length +/-0.05 mm acceptance), fixed by M3 x 8 socket head screws from below
M3 x 8 socket head screws (ISO 4762): 2 under the carrier into the stop standoffs, 2 clamping the pressure plate onto the stop tops at 0.3 N m

M4 spring plungers with an insulating (POM) thrust pin, 1.5 mm pin, 1.5 mm stroke, 15 mm long, threaded into the pressure plate at (14.1, 21.7) and (14.2, 16.5) board mm; free pin tip set 5.39 +/-0.1 mm below the plate underside; force at 0.62 and 1.30 mm compression each within +/-20 % of the catalogue line (5 N initial, 16 N final), total at least 12.7 N at every worst case
Cable tie through the base-plate slot and TP1-TP5 labels on both ends of the five green receptacle leads

blockers: No fixture part is selected: plates are digital designs and hardware lines are requirements. manifest.json#hardware_proposal lists one sourced candidate per line as a proposal awaiting owner approval; fabricator and supplier are owner choices.
Probe-plate bores leave 0.40 mm between bores at the fixed 1.4 mm test-point pitch: within the INGUN grid, below the 1.0 mm milled-wall guidance; the chosen fabricator must confirm drilling it.
No current price, MOQ, lead time or availability retrieved; no supplier-upload package.

services.requirement: Factory assembly. Controller: SMD on both sides (F and B) plus through-hole jacks and power header on F, from native pad attributes. Leaf: one-side SMD. Adapter: through-hole only. Quote, attrition, minimums, orientation, side order and process not approved
SWD programming identity and measured calibration; +3V3 voltage reference; exact LED-lot timing discrepancy #13 open

blockers.text: Order quantity is 2 modules (owner decision). JLC stock, price, minimum, packaging, lead time and assembly applicability at that quantity are not observed for any line except C221842 (switch-supply); JLC attrition is not sourced; stock never reserved.

PCM13SMTR (C221842): 2 needed for 2 modules. JLC stock 0 at 2026-11-09; at 2026-11-12 JLC lists it buyable (Extended) with pre-order minimum 3 and presale 0 (field meanings inferred), tier prices without currency, no lead time. The owner wants to complete on JLC: on our reading, a pre-order (presale 0 may mean none can be placed now; fill depends on LCSC stock, not observed) or a Global Sourcing quote; otherwise wait, or accept a reviewed alternate with its own contact table and fit review.

PJ-324M pin function (which of terminals 4/5 is the tip contact and which its normal; the supplier symbol contradicts the inferred 4 = tip, so this continuity test must precede any PCB order), slot, axis height and nut fit, and PCM13SMTR truth table and land fit, need received parts (jack-continuity, jack-dimensions, switch-fit).

Exact-part gaps after the 2026-11-11 source recovery: PMEG4010CEJ ,115 packing variant not established by the datasheet; SM04B-SRSS-TB per-circuit numbering not printed beyond the No. 1 end; PJ-324M recommended hole/slot sizes, axis height and whether a nut ships with C22355739 not sourced.
Finished A7 power cable (57 mm, +/-3 ASSUMED), SH4 cables and IDC ribbon not selected; supplier answers and the owner choice of assembly are needed before physical routing checks.
PMMA sheet and pocket tolerances, PETG process and orderable fastener part numbers are not sourced; the model carries designations (M2x18, M1.6x4) and envelopes only.
Owner rack rail/thread interface and fasteners not specified.

Fixture digital criteria 1-4 met and a sourced hardware proposal recorded; the fabricator choice and approval of the proposed hardware are owner decisions. Physical contact/load tests (criterion 5) follow.
No owner-approved prototype route, no reviewed manufacturing package and no release approval.
